notes: The inner type loop emitted its final done marker, but the frame does not show the enclosing signature-group return or later fixed-zone completion markers.
A current-only 333-byte range is not a complete boot trace; omitted later messages cannot be treated as a stop point.
The follow-up patch adds class/group identity and helper-return boundaries to the same fixed-zone path.
